title: Validating JWTs
description: Learn how JWT validation works and how to protect endpoints.

data.text: JWT validation verifies the token's signature, expiration, and claims. ASP.NET Core handles this automatically with the [Authorize] attribute.

data.title: Authorize
Claims
User Property
data.text: The User property on ControllerBase contains the authenticated user's claims from the JWT.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: JWT validation is automatic with proper configuration.
